description: This file defines the DecryptedItem class, which extends GenericItem and implements DecryptedItemInterface. It manages decrypted item data, including app-specific domain data, references, and equality checks.

classes.name: DecryptedItem
classes.description: A class representing a decrypted item with various properties and methods for managing item data, references, and equality checks.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Getter for the content of the payload.

methods.name: references
methods.description: Getter for the references associated with the item.

methods.name: isReferencingItem
methods.description: Checks if the item references another specified item.

methods.name: getDomainData
methods.description: Retrieves domain-specific data from appData based on the domain key.

methods.name: getAppDomainValue
methods.description: Gets a value from the default app domain data by key.

methods.name: getAppDomainValueWithDefault
methods.description: Gets a value from the default app domain data by key, with a default fallback.

methods.name: payloadRepresentation
methods.description: Returns a copy of the payload, optionally overridden.

methods.name: contentKeysToIgnoreWhenCheckingEquality
methods.description: Specifies content keys to ignore during equality checks.

methods.name: appDataContentKeysToIgnoreWhenCheckingEquality
methods.description: Specifies appData keys to ignore during equality checks.

methods.name: getContentCopy
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the content.

methods.name: isItemContentEqualWith
methods.description: Checks if this item’s content is equal to another item’s content, considering ignored keys.
